claimed_training_domains.note: The model can form poses, but exact photo/editorial composition is evaluated separately in VR Avatar Studio.

routing_labels.direct: Kimodo body motion is the primary generator.
routing_labels.pose_library: Use an authored pose for exact final composition; Kimodo may provide transitions.
routing_labels.hand_layer: Use Kimodo for body/arm placement and a semantic hand layer for finger articulation.
routing_labels.direct_with_speed_control: Use Kimodo directly but normalize root distance/speed after generation.
routing_labels.prop_constraint: Use Kimodo only with explicit prop/contact constraints or authored contact handling.

tested_support_labels.untested: No VR Avatar Studio use-case-specific generation review yet.
tested_support_labels.good: The requested body semantics are represented reliably enough for the intended route.
tested_support_labels.partial: Important parts are represented but exact semantics, ordering, contact, or pose composition are incomplete.
tested_support_labels.poor: The generated body motion is not reliable enough for direct use.
tested_support_labels.not_applicable: The request belongs to another layer such as camera or exact finger articulation.
